work: PRED-0017: Early-phase randomization and masking asymmetry benchmark across locked PRISMA-included Cystic Fibrosis interventional trials from PRED-0015 and PRED-0016.

claims.statement: Among 54 locked early-phase non-healthy-volunteer PRISMA-included systemic CFTR modulator and systemic PTC readthrough trials, 39 (0.722222: 40/54 randomized and 40/54 masked, 0 omitted fields) implement jointly RANDOMIZED allocation and masked blinding in ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 designInfo.

methods.name: schema-validated designInfo enum evaluator
methods.difference: parses design_module.designInfo through fail-closed NLM enum validator and counts systemic matches

methods.name: independent raw-JSON enum auditor
methods.difference: separate file with zero re, math, or shared imports; inspects raw JSON designInfo keys directly

claims.statement: Among 15 pure airway-restricted early-phase CFTR-restoring genetic, mRNA, viral-vector, liposomal, and splice-ASO trials, 6 (0.400000: NCT01621867, NCT02532764, NCT03375047, NCT05712538, NCT06429176, NCT06515002; and 7/17 = 0.411765 across all-inhaled adding NCT06237335) implement jointly RANDOMIZED allocation and masked blinding.

methods.name: schema-validated pure-inhaled designInfo evaluator
methods.difference: evaluates pure-route inhaled CFTR trials excluding dual-route co-administered systemic modulators

methods.name: independent raw-JSON pure-inhaled enum auditor
methods.difference: separate file with zero shared imports; counts pure-inhaled RANDOMIZED + masked records directly

claims.statement: Comparing 39/54 systemic vs 6/15 pure airway-restricted early-phase CFTR trials yields one-sided Fisher hypergeometric p = 20586899/867114268 (0.02374185 >= 0.01), and comparing 39/54 vs 7/17 all-inhaled trials yields p = 9351324175/430955791196 (0.02169903 >= 0.01).

methods.name: math.comb hypergeometric support summation
methods.difference: computes hypergeometric PMF numerator and denominator via math.comb

methods.name: multiplicative Fraction product summation
methods.difference: computes binomial coefficients via multiplicative Fraction products without importing math

claims.statement: On 39/54 systemic vs 6/15 pure airway-restricted early-phase CFTR trials (risk difference +0.322222), the sawtooth-safe unconditional Chan-Zhang 95% CI is [0.005320, 0.578285] and the Newcombe-Wilson Method-10 95% CI is [0.046513, 0.548120].

methods.name: Cardano trigonometric restricted-MLE + golden-section multi-peak Chan-Zhang CI95 lower bound
methods.difference: solves Miettinen-Nurminen cubic score via Cardano acos/cos and golden-section multi-peak polish in float64

methods.name: pure-Decimal log-likelihood Newton-bisection + ternary multi-peak Chan-Zhang CI95 lower bound
methods.difference: solves unexpanded log-likelihood derivative in Decimal with zero float pre-screening and ternary multi-peak polish

claims.statement: Pre-registered PRED-0017 hypothesis is refuted at the locked alpha = 0.01 Fisher threshold without post-hoc tuning: although systemic early-phase CFTR trials exceeded pure airway-restricted inhaled CFTR trials by +0.322222 (39/54 = 0.722222 vs 6/15 = 0.400000; Chan-Zhang 95% CI [0.005320, 0.578285]; Newcombe-Wilson 95% CI [0.046513, 0.548120]), one-sided Fisher hypergeometric p = 20586899/867114268 = 0.02374185 (and all-17 p = 0.02169903) exceeded 0.01 because 6/15 pure-inhaled trials (pGM169, eluforsen, MRT5005, ARCT-032, SPL84, BI 3720931) implemented randomized masked designs.

methods.name: float64 designInfo risk-difference evaluator
methods.difference: computes p_sys - p_inh_pure from schema-validated designInfo enums

methods.name: independent raw-JSON risk-difference auditor
methods.difference: computes p_sys - p_inh_pure from independent raw JSON enum evaluation
